d: Is the Modi government facing a new political challenge over allegations of “Vote Theft” and now “Rights Theft”? Congress leader Rahul Gandhi has raised serious questions over the alleged linking of government welfare schemes with Voter ID cards instead of Aadhaar. The controversy intensified after Union Minister Lalan Singh reportedly suggested that Aadhaar was no longer relevant and that benefits such as pensions, ration, and housing could be linked to Voter ID.
